adaptation: Soft pill. Variants default, outline, ghost, secondary, destructive and link. Sizes include the round icon squares. leadingIcon and trailingIcon, AnimatedIcon through leadingAnimate and trailingAnimate, a pending spinner that keeps the label laid out, and a 44px touch hit area.
Not a separate shadcn component: Button at its icon sizes, round, with the quieter toolbar ink. ghost and outline, press scale .94, aria-label required, animate draws an AnimatedIcon.

Soft field shell: field fill, md radius, field ring on focus, failed edge when aria-invalid. Sizes medium and small. Leading and trailing icon and addon slots. An empty date or time field hides WebKit's grey today through data-empty-picker.
Multiline sibling of Input in the same field shell. rows sets the resting height, autoResize grows up to maxRows, resize exposes the native grab handle.
18px box (16px at sm), line-strong edge, ink fill and an on-action mark when checked or indeterminate. children make the box and its words one label.

Ink track when on, line-strong when off. The thumb stretches while held and lands on the pop curve. Sizes compact, sm, md and lg; shape pill or rectangle. Always inside a label. checked and onCheckedChange.
20px pill for a kind, a count or a note, never a state (states use StateTag). default is ink-2, strong is ink, both on ink at 6%.
Field label, 13px semibold. required draws the asterisk. tooltip draws a static info mark; an explanation a person can open is InfoTip beside the label.

Soft state variants (neutral/done/failed/waiting/working), auto state icon with icon={false}, grid columns that appear only with an icon or action, AlertAction as a centred slot, role alert for failed and status otherwise (atomic); BoardUI notification inline card replaced.

Soft look. 400ms trigger delay, a press that does not close, a non-hoverable card, per-side caret, size variants, container and positionerClassName props, role=tooltip and aria-describedby while open, exported TOOLTIP_* constants.

Soft field-shell trigger and menu-style popup (140ms in, 100ms out via data-starting/ending-style, z-menu); size sm|md; SelectItem meta prop and reserved check slot; SelectBadge; popup portalled into the enclosing dialog or popover; scroll arrows omitted; AnimatedIcon chevron; non-modal by default.
